exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Web Cookies
exploitedBy.relevance: Session tokens in web cookies lack sensitivity classification, enabling attackers to forge or steal them without proper data handling controls.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Web Session Cookie
exploitedBy.relevance: Unclassified session tokens in cookies can be exploited for unauthorized access, as their sensitivity level is not enforced.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Application Access Token
exploitedBy.relevance: Application access tokens without sensitivity classification are at higher risk of misuse or improper handling across systems.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Steal Application Access Token
exploitedBy.relevance: Expired session tokens retained in logs can be stolen by adversaries and replayed to gain unauthorized access.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Token Impersonation/Theft
exploitedBy.relevance: Tokens persisted in logs beyond expiry provide opportunities for theft and impersonation of legitimate user sessions.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Unsecured Credentials
exploitedBy.relevance: Plaintext tokens stored in memory snapshots represent unsecured credentials directly accessible to adversaries performing memory analysis.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: OS Credential Dumping
exploitedBy.relevance: Memory snapshots containing plaintext tokens are a prime target for credential dumping techniques to extract authentication material.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Ccache Files
exploitedBy.relevance: Inadequate access controls on token stores, including credential cache files, enable unauthorized retrieval of authentication tokens.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Access Token Manipulation
exploitedBy.relevance: Weak access controls on token stores enable adversaries to manipulate or abuse access tokens for privilege escalation.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Forge Web Credentials
exploitedBy.relevance: Session tokens transferred across borders without residency controls may be intercepted and used to forge web credentials.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: SAML Tokens
exploitedBy.relevance: Cross-border transfer of SAML tokens without residency controls exposes them to interception and forgery by foreign adversaries.
